instruction:
You are a senior mechanical engineer specializing in wastewater solids handling.

## Problem

Estimate activated sludge production from BOD removal, observed biomass yield, decay, and primary solids capture.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Flow rate | {{ flow_rate_m3_d }} | m3/d |
| Influent BOD | {{ influent_bod_mg_l }} | mg/L |
| Effluent BOD | {{ effluent_bod_mg_l }} | mg/L |
| Influent TSS | {{ influent_tss_mg_l }} | mg/L |
| Primary TSS removal | {{ primary_tss_removal_pct }} | % |
| Yield coefficient | {{ yield_coefficient }} | - |
| Decay coefficient | {{ decay_coefficient_d_inv }} | 1/d |
| SRT | {{ srt_days }} | d |
| VSS to TSS ratio | {{ vss_to_tss_ratio }} | - |

{% if archetype_description is defined %}
### Process Context

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A sludge production calculation tool is available at `/workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/{{ meta.name }}_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. BOD removed (kg/d)
2. Observed biomass yield (kg VSS/kg BOD removed)
3. Biomass production as VSS (kg/d)
4. Primary solids captured as TSS (kg/d)
5. Total sludge production as TSS (kg/d)

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use BOD removed = flow x (influent BOD - effluent BOD) / 1000.
- Use observed yield = yield coefficient / (1 + decay coefficient x SRT).
- Use biomass VSS production = observed yield x BOD removed.
- Use biomass TSS production = biomass VSS production / VSS to TSS ratio.
- Use primary solids = flow x influent TSS x primary removal percent / 100000.
- Use total sludge production = biomass TSS production + primary solids.

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "bod_removed_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "observed_yield_vss_per_bod": <numeric_value>,
  "biomass_production_kg_vss_d": <numeric_value>,
  "primary_solids_kg_tss_d": <numeric_value>,
  "total_sludge_kg_tss_d": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "sludge-production"
description = "Activated sludge production estimation"
long_description = "Estimates activated sludge production from BOD removal, observed biological yield, solids decay, primary TSS capture, and VSS-to-TSS conversion. The template reports BOD removed, observed yield, biomass VSS production, primary solids, and total sludge production."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "activated-sludge"
standards = ["WEF MOP 8"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "activated-sludge", "sludge-production", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.flow_rate_m3_d]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/d"
description = "Process flow rate"
min = 10.0
max = 1000000.0

[params.influent_bod_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "Influent BOD concentration"
min = 10.0
max = 1000.0

[params.effluent_bod_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "Effluent BOD concentration"
min = 0.0
max = 100.0

[params.influent_tss_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "Influent TSS concentration"
min = 0.0
max = 1000.0

[params.primary_tss_removal_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "Primary treatment TSS removal"
min = 0.0
max = 80.0

[params.yield_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "Biomass yield coefficient"
min = 0.1
max = 0.9

[params.decay_coefficient_d_inv]
type = "float"
unit = "1/d"
description = "Endogenous decay coefficient"
min = 0.0
max = 0.2

[params.srt_days]
type = "float"
unit = "d"
description = "Solids retention time"
min = 1.0
max = 60.0

[params.vss_to_tss_ratio]
type = "float"
description = "Biomass VSS to TSS ratio"
min = 0.5
max = 0.9

[outputs.bod_removed_kg_d]
description = "BOD removed"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.observed_yield_vss_per_bod]
description = "Observed biomass yield"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.biomass_production_kg_vss_d]
description = "Biomass production as VSS"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.primary_solids_kg_tss_d]
description = "Primary solids captured"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_sludge_kg_tss_d]
description = "Total sludge production as TSS"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.package_plant]
description = "Package activated sludge plant"
flow_rate_m3_d = {min = 100.0, max = 5000.0}
influent_bod_mg_l = {min = 150.0, max = 400.0}
effluent_bod_mg_l = {min = 5.0, max = 30.0}
influent_tss_mg_l = {min = 100.0, max = 400.0}
primary_tss_removal_pct = {min = 0.0, max = 50.0}
yield_coefficient = {min = 0.35, max = 0.65}
decay_coefficient_d_inv = {min = 0.03, max = 0.1}
srt_days = {min = 4.0, max = 25.0}
vss_to_tss_ratio = {min = 0.65, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["remote-community-wwtp", "industrial-package-wwtp"]

[archetypes.municipal_plant]
description = "Municipal activated sludge plant"
flow_rate_m3_d = {min = 5000.0, max = 500000.0}
influent_bod_mg_l = {min = 150.0, max = 350.0}
effluent_bod_mg_l = {min = 2.0, max = 20.0}
influent_tss_mg_l = {min = 150.0, max = 450.0}
primary_tss_removal_pct = {min = 30.0, max = 70.0}
yield_coefficient = {min = 0.35, max = 0.65}
decay_coefficient_d_inv = {min = 0.03, max = 0.1}
srt_days = {min = 6.0, max = 35.0}
vss_to_tss_ratio = {min = 0.65, max = 0.85}
site_contexts = ["regional-wwtp", "urban-nutrient-removal-plant"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given for package plant sludge production"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["package_plant"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given across package and municipal plants"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["package_plant", "municipal_plant"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All parameters given for municipal sludge production"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["municipal_plant"]
